title: Christmas Paper Texture Brush Stamps
author: JeerawanTH
description:
This is a set of brushes for the Procreate app.
– For this set, you will receive 24 brushes.
– The brushes can be customized with 2 colors at the same time.
– The brushes can be adjusted to 3 different sizes, up to the largest size, and they have high clarity.
– I hope you enjoy creating with these brushes.
Procreate Stamps are so much fun! They save your time and help you easily create amazing artworks. You can use them for branding, packaging, printing products. You can make beautiful posters, greeting cards, fabric.
